description: This Java class 'ProductContentWrapper' manages the retrieval, caching, and rendering of product content within the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements the ContentWrapper interface and provides methods to obtain product content in text form, either from cache or by querying the database, with support for different content types and encodings.

classes.name: ProductContentWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps product content retrieval, rendering, and caching logic, implementing the ContentWrapper interface within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeProductContentWrapper
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ProductContentWrapper with a product and HTTP request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the product content as a string wrapper for a specified content type and encoder.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText (overloaded)
methods.description: Static methods to get the product content as plain text, either directly from a request or with explicit locale and dispatcher.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText
methods.description: Core static method: retrieves product content as text, utilizing cache if available, from product data or by querying content entities.

methods.name: getProductContentAsText (with Writer)
methods.description: Static method: renders product content into a Writer object, supporting cache control.
